headline: Quiet Saturday as earlier stories fade
body: Nothing new was scored today. A few endings shifted by a few hundredths as earlier announcements faded, and Horizon Balance sits at -2.28. The ranking is unchanged: Enslaved God leads at 37.11, with Libertarian Utopia second at 25.48 and 1984 third.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Descendants -0.06 and Zookeeper -0.06.
